## Context
This repo-level spec describes the overall purpose of the sample project. It exists
purely as a validator fixture — the content is illustrative, not a real project spec.

## Goals
- Provide a lightweight workflow-memory toolkit for coding agents.

## Capabilities
- Structured planning, review, and quality-gate artifacts under `.workflow_artifacts/`.

## Acceptance criteria
- The repo builds and its test suite passes on a clean checkout.

## Non-goals
- Replacing a full project-management system.
